data.title: Argentina Bonds Enter Distressed Territory for First Time in Two Years Amid Global Risk-Off
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Argentina’s debt slipped into distressed territory for the first time in two years as a global flight from risk deepened a bond selloff fueled by anxiety over next year’s election.

data.description: Microsoft Corp. is making compensation in its cloud division more performance-based, paying top workers more and cracking down on others, Bloomberg reported. The move is the latest tech industry effort to push employees to work harder.

data.title: Trump Vows to Bar U.S. Companies From Building Data Centers Abroad, Threatens 'Tremendous Tax'

data.title: JPMorgan Faces Up to £120 Million in UK Bank Tax; Jamie Dimon Says It Will Hedge the Cost
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon said the bank would seek to offset the cost of the UK’s higher bank tax, which is expected to add up to £120 million to its tax bill.

Dimon made the remarks at a private event on Thursday, according to attendees, and at the JPMorgan European Financial Conference. He said the move was intended to set an example and show the government the trade-offs of what he called unfair taxation. He described his response as driven more by regret than anger but did not specify how the bank would offset the higher cost. JPMorgan declined to comment.

The increase in the bank surcharge, raised by three percentage points to 6% from 3% in Chancellor John Healey’s first budget, followed Dimon’s criticism of the proposal. JPMorgan has said the decision lacked principle and ignored the banking sector’s highly competitive global market. The bank had feared the surcharge would rise to 8%, the level before Rishi Sunak lowered it in 2021. Healey’s plan sets the higher rate for 15 months, and banking executives are concerned it may remain in place after that period.

Rules introduced after the 2008 financial crisis require banks operating in the UK to pay additional taxes, including a balance-sheet tax and a profits surcharge, on top of standard corporate tax. JPMorgan has about 23,000 employees in the UK, including at its European headquarters in London and its campus in Bournemouth.

Dimon has led JPMorgan since 2006 and has been among the most prominent critics of UK plans to increase taxes on the financial sector. Before the budget, he spoke with Healey to oppose the proposed increase and publicly warned that higher taxes would harm the banking sector and the broader economy. Healey said in his budget speech that he expected banks to contribute to helping UK households amid difficult economic conditions.

Last year, former Chancellor Rachel Reeves planned a tax increase on banks, but the sector secured concessions. In November last year, Dimon approved a new 3-million-square-foot building in Canary Wharf after government advisers gave assurances about the UK’s business-friendly policies. The project was announced the day after Reeves presented her budget. JPMorgan said at the time that it depended on continued improvement in the UK business environment.

data.title: Whale Sells 47,900 ETH Worth $89.1 Million in Two Sales Within Days to Repay Loans
data.description: An unidentified whale sold 15,349 ETH at $1,701 each during a market decline, receiving $26.1 million to repay a loan in full. According to Odaily, Lookonchain reported that the whale had sold 32,541 ETH at $1,938 each for $63 million a few days earlier during a market decline to repay a loan on Aave.

data.title: Jim Cramer’s Investing Club Looks to Buy Advanced Micro Devices After 11% Drop
data.description: According to CNBC, Advanced Micro Devices shares fell 11% Friday, and Jim Cramer’s Investing Club is still looking to make small purchases when possible. The club’s portfolio director, Jeff Marks, said they are restricted from trading the stock because Cramer discussed it on television. The decline followed a report from short seller Hunterbrook Media alleging that a blacklisted Chinese company continued receiving AMD firmware that enables its chips to run in servers; AMD disputed the claims.

data.title: KKR's Helix Negotiates EdgeCore Stake at $8 Billion-Plus Valuation
data.description: According to Bloomberg, KKR & Co.’s Helix Digital Infrastructure is negotiating to buy a majority stake in EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure at a valuation of at least $8 billion, people familiar with the matter said. KKR launched Helix this year to invest in data centers and other AI-related businesses.

data.title: Goldman Sachs Forecasts Inflation at 2.4% by End of 2027
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Goldman Sachs expects inflation to cool to 2.4% by the end of 2027 as tariff, energy and AI-related pressures fade. Chief US Economist David Mericle said the Federal Reserve may still raise rates in December and March while awaiting clearer evidence that inflation is easing.
